sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: Casa dell’Architettura of Rome announces the second edition of CONTEMPORANEA Call for Proposal (October–December 2026), with the aim of supporting original research and reflections in the field of contemporary architecture. The Call for Proposal aims selecting architects, planners, landscape architects and/or conservation specialists developing an experimental research project, to be carried out through the use of the space “Monitor P” at the Casa dell’Architettura of Rome, identified as a permanent laboratory for research, production, and exchange. The project must be consistent with the annual theme of the CONTEMPORANEA programme, exploring the concept of “Contaminations” through interdisciplinary approaches, design practices, and applied
